rubrics.justification: The response conflicts with the provided Gardner score 3AB by describing an early cavitating blastocyst with intact zona and estimating 2BB/3BB; it underrates ICM quality and mischaracterizes expansion stage.
It integrates most relevant factors well, including age, tubal factor, prior ectopic/miscarriage, sperm quality, endometrium, BMI, and lifestyle, and relates them to prognosis.
The overall logic is structured, but conclusions are partly weakened by the incorrect morphology reassessment and some overinterpretation of prior ectopic/implantation history.

SET recommendation and general counseling are guideline-consistent, but suggesting thrombophilia screening after a single miscarriage and implying PGT-A based mainly on that history are not strongly guideline-based.
Provides practical next steps for transfer counseling, lifestyle modification, uterine review, and future-cycle considerations, though some recommendations are broader than necessary for this case.
